name: M5 Forecasting Accuracy Dataset
description: The M5 competition dataset contains hierarchical retail sales data donated by Walmart. It includes daily unit sales for 3,049 products categorized into 3 product categories and 7 departments across 10 stores in California, Texas, and Wisconsin over 1,941 days (2011-2016), accompanied by pricing, promotional, calendar, and SNAP benefit features.
